textRuns.value: Source: BDIFF (bdiff.agriculture.gouv.fr, ministry of agriculture), paginated search export covering 2006 to 2026. Prometheus, the former Mediterranean register, was merged into BDIFF in January 2023, so the series changes composition at that point. BDIFF counts declared fires including very small ones, while EFFIS maps perimeters above a detection floor: the two are measuring different things and must not be added or compared.
